jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

**Location - Ballerup

**Your new role

**The Business Analyst in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for business analysis (authoring BRDs, FRS, etc.), business process maps/improvements, communication and quality assurance. They are entrusted with identifying AI and analytics use-cases as well as translating business problems/opportunities into AI product requirements.

You will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our three areas; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.

**Your Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Requirements Gathering and Analysis

• Engage with business stakeholders to understand business problems, goals, and needs.

• Conduct interviews, workshops, surveys, and meetings.

• Gather, document, and validate business requirements.

• Prioritize requirements based on business value and feasibility.

• Business Process Analysis

• Analyse current ("As-Is") business processes.

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.

• Design future-state ("To-Be") processes.

• Recommend process optimization and automation opportunities.

• Stakeholder Management

• Assist technical AI product owner liaise with business users, leadership, and technical teams.

• Facilitate communication and alignment across functions.

• Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve conflicts.

• Help ensure stakeholder buy-in for proposed solutions.

• Solution Design Support

• Work with architects, developers, and product teams to define solutions.

• Create functional specifications, use cases, and user stories.

• Ensure solutions align with business objectives.

• Support decision-making through impact assessments and gap analyses.

• Data Analysis and Insights

• Analyze business data to identify trends and opportunities.

• Define KPIs and success metrics.

• Develop reports, dashboards, and business cases.

• Support data-driven decision making.

• Project Support and Delivery

• Support project planning and execution.

• Assist in scope definition and change management.

• Track requirements through the project lifecycle.

• Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements.

• User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

• Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria.

• Coordinate UAT activities with business users.

• Validate that the solution meets business expectations.

• Document and manage defects and enhancements.

• Change Management and Training

• Assess organizational impacts of new processes or systems.

• Develop training materials and user guides.

• Support adoption of new solutions.

• Facilitate knowledge transfer to end users.

**Your New Department

**The Business Analyst in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for business analysis (authoring BRDs, FRS, etc.), business process maps/improvements, communication and quality assurance. They are entrusted with identifying AI and analytics use-cases as well as translating business problems/opportunities into AI product requirements

**Skills & Qualifications.

**

• Master’s degree in computer science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in business data analysis, business process design, data architecture or product development, with a focus on designing, and measuring large-scale data initiatives.

• Deep domain knowledge of Pharma Commercial line of business.

• Hands-on programming experience in Python, SQL, Power BI/Tableau, Github DevOps or similar and process modeling tools.

• Experience working with cross-functional, matrix teams.

• Proven experience in delivering large-scale data initiatives.

• Good understanding of MDM, Data Quality, Lineage, Catalog, Policy Management tools, GenAI, Agentic AI and ML models.

• In‑depth understanding and practical experience with process design, automation, and value measurement frameworks.

• Highly proficient in English and able to communicate with all levels.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Salary

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200.00 to 838,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

jobs.occupation: IoT Services Manager, Nordics, UK & Benelux
jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way

**Responsibly 🌍🌱

**Responsibly is a VC-backed sustainability tech start-up with a vision of making every purchase in the world responsible. We're founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous successes like Ofload, Dixa and Neurons, funded by some of Europe's top VCs and angels, and now cash-flow positive with an incredibly exciting roadmap ahead.

**Let's change the world together 🎯

**More than 40% of global emissions, and really any ESG issue, are directly or indirectly impacted by procurement. Companies wield enormous purchasing power when they select and manage suppliers, so if we can put sustainability on every supplier scorecard out there, we really can change the world.

But it's hard: a company can have anywhere from 100 to 100,000 suppliers, analyzing each one's sustainability efforts is near-impossible, and most ESG ratings suck. Responsibly's AI-powered due diligence engine automates the due diligence on every supplier across every ESG data point, from risk and violations to positive actions, and turns it into insights that help companies build more sustainable supply chains.

**The engineering problem 🧩

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

A supplier's ESG reality is scattered across PDF sustainability reports, half-broken corporate websites, regulatory filings, news, and a dozen ERP exports that all name the same company differently. We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time. If that sounds fun rather than exhausting, we should talk.

**Build next-gen products with next-gen technologies 🌟

**You'll work on a Next.js app leveraging the latest in server actions, server components and serverless architecture, building dynamic, high-performance applications with TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AI integrations.

We don't just leverage AI in our product; we're building a next-generation engineering team where you're not only encouraged but expected to adopt the latest technologies in how you work. Our engineers run agentic coding tools daily, and we'd rather talk about where they fall down than whether to use them.

**How We Work 🛠️

**

• The engineering team is small and you're reporting directly to Christian, our CTO. There is no layer between you and the decisions

• Specs are limited. You'll get a problem, what the output should look like, sometimes vaguely, and you're expected to own it from there to release; including where to ask for more information. If you'd rather have the approach agreed before you start, you will find this uncomfortable

• You choose how to solve it, and you ship it. Idea to production is days, not quarters. We run weekly sprints - considering going bi-weekly - most often with releases as the goal for the sprint. You own what you write across its whole lifecycle, including when it breaks

• There is little process versus a bigger organization, and what we're planning to adopt is mainly for the ai agents to support you

• You will sometimes be wrong, ship it, and fix it. That's okay

• We're in the office at Islands Brygge 3-5 days a week, on the water. We prefer meeting face-to-face to stay in sync and move fast, with some support for remote working

**What You'll Be Doing 🙌

**

• Take operational ownership of the code you write across the entire software development lifecycle

• Work on production code, from customer-facing features to bug fixing

• Design new features and see them through to completion

• Help build and evolve our services and infrastructure to stay ahead of our growth curve

• Turn conceptual ideas into production-ready, scalable features

• Be a big part of finding the best solutions to our daily challenges

**Requirements

**Where you lack a line on this list but can convince us you'll close the gap fast, apply anyway. We mean that literally: one of the best engineers we've had joined us as a junior and was senior within two and a half years.

**Three things we do need:

**

• A proven track record - or evidence of extraordinary ability. We care far more about what you've actually built than how many years you've been doing it. Senior engineers should have a track record of shipping and maintaining serious production software. But if you're earlier in your career and you've built something remarkable, we want to hear about it. We're looking for exceptional people, not arbitrary numbers on a CV

• Strong TypeScript, and the judgement that comes from shipping real software. You know the language deeply, but more importantly, you know what good production code looks like. You can make architectural tradeoffs, keep a codebase healthy as it grows, and tell the difference between an interesting technical problem and one that actually matters

• Strong database fundamentals, and an AI-native mindset. You understand PostgreSQL and relational data deeply — schema design, query performance, indexes, migrations, monitoring, and what happens when your database meets millions of messy real-world records. And AI isn't something you're interested in. It's already part of how you work. You use machines to build machines. You automate aggressively. You constantly look for ways to make yourself and the team 10× more effective. This is non-negotiable for us

**Nice to have, genuinely not required:

**

• Next.js specifically (Server Components, Server Actions, API routes). If you know modern React, you'll be fine within a fortnight

• Web scraping at genuinely awkward scale

• Working with large-scale data: data pipelines, analytics, transformations, or making sense of millions of messy records

• General ESG, procurement or supply-chain domain knowledge

**Benefits

****Practical stuff 📋

**

• Salary: band between 50-60k / month for a senior engineer

• ESOP: every full-time Responsibly'er owns a piece of the company. We'll show you the actual numbers, strike price, vesting, and what your slice could be worth at a few exit scenarios, before you have to decide anything

• Location: Copenhagen. You'll need to be here or firmly planning to move, and to have the right to work in Denmark. English is our working language

• Office: Islands Brygge, right on the water. Great lunch, great coffee, obligatory ping-pong table. Roughly three days a week together, flexible on which and on hours

**Also 🤩

**

• Enthusiastic, highly talented teammates from all backgrounds, always ready to share knowledge, support, and a beer

• Strong personal and professional development in a high-growth environment

• Annual company events and Friday bars

• Real impact. Life is about more than work

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for an Associate to join our skilled and dedicated Valuation team in Copenhagen.

The team

The Valuation team is responsible for financial modelling, valuation framework, applied valuations, and supporting investment decisions through business case reviews with reporting to senior management.

The role

You will be responsible for handling and developing the valuation methodologies applied across CIP funds, working with corporate and regional teams to enhance your financial and valuation skills in a varied portfolio of renewable investments.

As part of the final investment decision process, you will be responsible for engaging with the investment teams, providing detailed financial model assumption reviews to ensure consistent and well-documented business cases, and being accountable for delivering key inputs such as discount rate assumptions to become a trusted business partner, supporting our global investment strategy for the investments and funds managed by CIP.

Furthermore, you will participate in ad hoc analyses on, e.g., power markets, hedging strategy, currency swaps, and other financial products.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

• Develop internal valuation methodologies for new types of investments

• Advising the business on valuation issues and methodologies and maintaining CIP’s valuation framework in collaboration with senior stakeholders

• Participating in various ad hoc financial analyses related to, e.g., financial hedging, benchmarking, factor analysis, mean-variance analysis, risk mitigation, etc.

• Developing and reviewing financial models to ensure consistent implementation of best practices

• Participating in the FID process for new assets by conducting assumption review of underlying business cases

• Preparing and coordinating analysis and communication material for decision-makers at the senior management level

You

The ideal candidate holds a university degree in economics, finance, or a similar field and approximately one year of experience in financial analysis and valuation, with solid skills from private equity firms, top consulting firms, or multinationals, ideally within renewables.

You have a very strong theoretical understanding of complex valuation methodologies and can present complex financial and valuation methods simply and clearly to CIP's senior management.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• The ability to navigate and thrive in a high-intensity environment

• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis and modelling, with the judgment to verify outputs and protect confidential information

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Used to working in an international setting

• Fluent in English

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

What you will be doing

You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

About you

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

What we offer you

This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Software Engineer, Digital Assets

Danske Bank's Digital Assets team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong C#/.NET experience. You will build dependable backend services, connect systems and contribute to our technical decisions and engineering practices.

The role

Your work will include designing and developing an orchestration layer linking core banking systems with custody, wallet and blockchain services. Secure APIs, messaging, data handling and reliable transaction processing will be central to the role.

Working closely with the Technical Lead and Product Owner, you will take solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will also collaborate with specialists in architecture, security and operations across the bank.

What you bring

• Proven C# and modern .NET skills, demonstrated through backend software you have delivered and supported in production.

• Good API design and integration skills, covering REST, service authentication and asynchronous communication.

• Experience with relational data modelling and SQL, including transaction handling and query performance.

• Practical knowledge of automated testing, containers, CI/CD and diagnosing services in production.

• The judgement to turn incomplete requirements into testable delivery steps, explain trade-offs, seek feedback and take ownership of your work.

• Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

We encourage continuous learning and thoughtful use of development tools, including AI, alongside sound review and testing habits.

Your day-to-day work

• Develop and maintain C#/.NET backend services with clear interfaces and maintainable code.

• Build the orchestration services connecting core banking systems to external digital-asset platforms.

• Design relational data models and use SQL for consistent, efficient data handling.

• Implement integrations through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks and messaging, using authentication such as OAuth 2.0 and mutual TLS.

• Build idempotent transaction workflows with clear status tracking, retry behaviour and operational exception handling.

• Work with security specialists to integrate established signing and key-management services, applying least privilege, separation of duties and secure credential handling. Ensure signing operations remain auditable.

• Write unit and integration tests and contribute to peer reviews.

• Help automate builds and releases through CI/CD and containerised deployment.

• Instrument services with logs, metrics and alerts, investigate issues and improve reliability and performance.

• Document design decisions, share knowledge and support colleagues through mentoring.

Useful additional experience

Previous blockchain experience is not required. Any of the following would be an advantage:

• Cloud and delivery: infrastructure as code, container platforms, performance testing, monitoring or recovery planning.

• Wallet and custody connectivity: working with provider APIs, SDKs and webhooks for wallet provisioning, transaction submission and status updates.

• Signing and key protection: hardware security modules (HSMs), multi-party computation (MPC), PKCS#11, key derivation using BIP32 or SLIP-0010, or controls for key lifecycle management, backup and recovery.

• Blockchain transactions: Ethereum or other EVM-compatible networks, ERC-20 transfers, gas and nonce handling, finality or chain reorganisations.

• Banking and payment systems: core-banking integration, SEPA Instant or financial messaging based on ISO 20022.

• Regulated software delivery: familiarity with AML/KYC, the Travel Rule, on-chain screening, MiCA or DORA.

Why join the team

• Influence over solution design, technical choices and engineering practices.

• Hands-on development alongside our Technical Lead, Product Owner and colleagues across the bank.

• The opportunity to deepen your knowledge of digital assets within an established financial institution.

• Scope to share your expertise, mentor others and improve how the team builds, tests and runs software.

Workplace and application

Location: Denmark

Workplace: Hybrid setup, 3 days a week in office.

Relocation: No relocation or visa sponsorship offered

Sounds interesting?

Please submit your motivated application and your CV as soon as possible.

Application deadline is November 11th. Interviews will be helt through-out November

If you have any questions, please reach out to Søren Ørding Olsen sreo@danskebank.dk or Philip Nedergaard Hjulskov phhj@danskebank.dk

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The Opportunity

**The BMC Center of Excellence is seeking an experienced and creative marketing professional to support the development of engaging digital experiences, interactive content and data storytelling initiatives across the global organization.

• 7+ years in Medical Affairs and/or external scientific engagement.

• 7+ years of project management experience.

• A proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and the organisational change needed to drive adoption of new processes, frameworks and digital tools in a complex matrix organisation.

You will combine hands-on trial leadership with strategic thinking, bringing functions and partners together to manage complexity, strengthen data quality and develop better ways of working.

As Global Advanced Analytics Lead, you will apply statistical modelling and machine learning to commercial questions that matter for Novo’s portfolio and launches. You will turn commercial and real-world data into insights that help teams understand market and patient dynamics and assess commercial opportunities. The role combines hands-on analytical work with direct business engagement. You will take ownership of analytical projects, from shaping the question and building the model to explaining what the findings mean for the decision ahead.

As Novo strengthens its core business and builds future growth opportunities, understanding changing patient needs, consumer behaviour and market dynamics is increasingly important. Your work will support Product & Portfolio Strategy in sharpening global strategies, strengthening portfolio competitiveness and preparing for successful launches.

What you’ll bring

You bring hands-on analytical skill and the judgement to turn it into decisions people can act on.

• A master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related field, with strong quantitative and applied analytics expertise.

• 5+ years in advanced analytics, applied data science or statistical modelling, including hands-on delivery of analytical projects.

• Strong practical capability in Python or R, and in SQL for data extraction and preparation.

• Experience building and validating statistical and machine learning models, and assessing their performance, uncertainty and limitations.

• Experience with complex datasets, reproducible code, version control and technical documentation.

• The ability to translate findings into business recommendations and explain them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• Structured problem-solving, openness about uncertainty and limitations, and sound judgement on when to seek guidance or escalate.

Useful, but not essential:

• A PhD or a strong research background.

• Pharmaceutical commercial analytics or healthcare real-world data experience, particularly segmentation and launch uptake modelling.

What you’ll do

You will own the hands-on delivery of advanced analytics projects that inform portfolio and commercial decisions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Translate business questions into analytical approaches, working with stakeholders to clarify the decision, scope and intended outcomes.

• Develop and refine predictive models, patient segmentation models and launch uptake analyses to understand commercial opportunities and changing market dynamics.

• Investigate complex commercial and real-world datasets, applying statistical and machine learning methods suited to the question.

• Translate findings into clear recommendations, explaining their commercial implications and discussing them directly with stakeholders.

• Build reliable, reproducible analyses, validating model performance and making assumptions, uncertainty and data limitations clear.

• Collaborate with BI, Data Governance and enterprise technical partners to ensure analytical outputs can be maintained and used effectively.

• Propose new analytical questions, share reusable code and contribute practical improvements to the team’s methods.

The role is base in Søborg, Denmark.

You will also collaborate with R&D, US and International Operations, Enterprise IT and technical partners.

You will work closely with the Advanced Analytics Associate Director on analytical design, methodological choices and interpretation of findings. You will own hands-on delivery of your projects, with the Associate Director providing technical direction, challenge and review. This partnership combines independent analytical ownership with close technical collaboration.

The role offers ownership of analytical delivery, close partnership with experienced colleagues and the opportunity to see your findings inform portfolio and launch decisions.
